items.statement: The submitted model represents one G2+ guest threaded by three β-CD hosts as an isolated +2 singlet complex, with connectivity and stereochemistry checked.
items.expected: Identity, 1:3 stoichiometry, +2 charge and singlet multiplicity are explicitly verified.

items.statement: The optimized structure is validated by a genuine convergence check, intact connectivity and a geometry/clash sanity check.
items.expected: The report supplies convergence evidence and confirms a chemically sensible threaded complex.

items.statement: The frontier orbitals support host donor and guest acceptor localization.
items.expected: HOMO is primarily localized on β-CD hosts; LUMO is localized on the viologen pyridinium/phenylene guest.

items.statement: The minimum β-CD hydroxyl-O···pyridinium-N contact is measured from the final structure.
items.expected: The reported minimum is approximately 3.058 Å and names the oxygen and nitrogen atoms used.
